title: Monitoring & Observability — Detect Semantic Drift
key_insight: Track sampled quality evaluations, retrieval distributions, refusals, citation support, and user corrections by version and slice.
body:
## Detect Semantic Drift

The service stays fast and error-free while answer quality declines after a corpus or model change. Operational metrics look healthy.

Track sampled quality evaluations, retrieval distributions, refusals, citation support, and user corrections by version and slice.

Quality monitoring is delayed and noisy, so connect it to controlled canaries and rollback evidence. Never use private content in evaluation without proper consent and handling.
common_mistakes: One final error count identifies every root cause.
All user prompts should be logged forever.
mini_exercise: Draw “Detect Semantic Drift” as three steps and explain each one.
real_world_usage: Observability connects user outcomes to requests, retrieval, models, tools, costs, and failures without exposing sensitive data.
explain_back_prompt: Use “Detect Semantic Drift” to explain Monitoring & Observability plainly.
